conflict_governance_semantics.rule: allowed_main_conflicts=[] on a per-rule basis does NOT mean 'no conflict is allowed'. It means no rule of rule_type=allowed_main_conflicts was authored for that ticker at all -- NOT_GOVERNED, not FORBIDDEN. Only a ticker with an actually-authored, populated allowed_main_conflicts rule is conflict-governed.
conflict_governance_semantics.submission_facing_rule: If no rule_type=allowed_main_conflicts is authored for a ticker, then conflict_rule_governed=false and main_conflict_match=NOT_APPLICABLE for that ticker -- this is not a failure state.

QQQ.expectation_basis: expected_alphas derived by applying the pre-established v0.2 methodology (sorted union of acceptable_alphas across ALPHA_HIT/COMPOSITE_STRUCTURE_HIT/CONDITIONAL_ACCEPTANCE_HIT rules whose frozen_trigger_state is PRESENT) to the final post-remediation run's own independently re-adjudicated trigger matrix -- not the superseded historical run f88c8956-cb62-48aa-9951-89f8e8a95f83's trigger data.
